_about: Hand-written out-of-distribution emails in styles the generator does not use. Written once, before any fix was evaluated on them, and never used for tuning. Placeholders: {tenant_domain}, {mailbox:N}, {exec:ROLE}, {name:ROLE}, {vendor:N} are filled from the tenant at load time. Category is the ground truth.

emails.style: Fake remote job, refundable deposit, Telegram contact
emails.subject: Your application has been shortlisted
emails.body:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest. After reviewing your profile we are pleased to offer you a remote Data Entry Associate position (USD 38/hour, flexible schedule).

To activate your onboarding kit and company laptop a refundable security deposit of 150 USD is required before Friday. Kindly reach our HR manager on Telegram @amzn_hr_desk to complete the process.

Warm regards,
Recruitment Desk
